units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 25b:8">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>ושיַעֲשִׁיר</he> and he who desires to become rich.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33a:26">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>הֶעֱשִׁירוּ קבעוה וכ׳</he> when they became wealthy, they made it a custom to recite the Habdalah over a cup.
<cite ref="Nedarim 38a:7">Ned. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>לא ה׳ משה וכ׳</he> Moses became rich from the chips of the tablets; a. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 48a:12">Keth. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>לאו כל הימנו שיעשיר וכ׳</he> he is not permitted to enrich his children and throw himself on the charities.
Ḥull. 84ᵇ (expl. עשתרת, Deut. VII, 13) שמַעֲשִׁירוֹת את בעליהן Ar. (ed. שמְעַשְּׁרוֹת, Pi.) for they make their owners rich; Yalk. Deut. 848 שמעשרות.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:11:1">Cant. R. to VII, 11</cite> (ref. to <he>תעשרנה</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 65:10">Ps. LXV, 10</cite>) <he>אם זכיתם תַּעֲשִׁיֶרנָּה ואם לאו תְּעַשְּׂרֶנָּה וכ׳</he> if you deserve well (it reads:) ‘thou makest her rich’, if not, ‘thou reducest her to one-tenth’, that she yield you only one-tenth; a. e.

senses.gloss: <cite ref="P01497">same</cite>; v. supra. B. Bath. l. c., v. infra.

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 119a:7">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 9a:2">Taan. 9ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>עשר תעשר</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 14:22">Deut. XIV, 22</cite>) <he>עַשֵּׂר בשביל שתִּתְעַשֵּׂר</he> give tithes in order that thou become rich. B. Bath. l. c. <he>מתוך שמתחכם מִתְעַשֵּׁר</he> for when he grows wise, he will also grow rich; (Ms. M. <he>חכמתו מְעַשַּׁרְתּוֹ</he> his wisdom makes him rich).

Pes. 50ᵇ עשרים … שלא יִתְעַשְּׁרוּ שאילמלי מִתְעַשְּׁרִין וכ׳ the men of the Great Assembly held twenty-four fasts to pray that the copyists of sacred books &c. might not become rich, for if they grew rich, they would not write; a. fr.—[2) (b. h.) to pretend to be rich, to pass for a rich man.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 24:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIV</cite>.]
